consequence.statement: gRPC communication to the control plane fails with authentication handshake errors when using cert-manager's istio-csr versions prior to v0.12.1, due to increased validation checks for ALPN properties.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade cert-manager's istio-csr to v0.12.1 or later, or apply the workaround settings mentioned in the release notes.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 introduces increased validation checks in gRPC communication to the control plane that are incompatible with cert-manager's istio-csr versions prior to v0.12.1, causing authentication handshake failures.
